hooks.name: Seeded-ghost recall check
hooks.description: When a sample dead config is edited, remind the agent to keep the GHOST annotations and the autopsy recall test in sync.

action.prompt: A sample config was edited. 1) Verify every intentionally haunted rule carries a '! GHOST: <type>' comment on the line directly above it, and every deliberately unsupported line carries '! UNSUPPORTED:' or '! EXPECT-UNPARSED:'. 2) Verify only RFC 5737/RFC 1918 addresses and no real names or secrets are present. 3) If ACE order or content changed, re-check by hand every vector in samples/golden-flows/<same-name>.toml (rule ids are <acl>#<ordinal>) and update expectations only with a note citing .kiro/steering/policy-semantics.md. Never regenerate golden flows from evaluate.py output. 4) Run `cd backend && uv run pytest -q tests/test_autopsy_recall.py tests/test_golden_flows.py`.
